hypothesis: Frozen metro geometric detector transfers to independently annotated railway objects without per-object tuning.
success_criterion: Report every eligible independently authored cuboid, including invisible and unsupported targets. No precision claim because class-agnostic infrastructure predictions and image-only objects make labels nonexhaustive for this detector.
note: Outdoor German standard-gauge railway, not target metro domain. LiDAR coordinates are already forward/left/up with railhead z=0. Apply a fixed -1.7m vertical translation to points and labels for the detector's sensor-height convention. Only gauge and coordinate adapter change; detector segmentation ROI remains frozen. No threshold or object selection based on predictions. Fused six-lidar points are not treated as a single-scanner deskew model.
